_notes.purpose: Authoritative catalog of Stripe products and prices for the membership system. Use `bin/stripe-import-catalog.php db/catalog.json` to apply to whichever Stripe mode the configured STRIPE_SECRET_KEY targets (test or live).
_notes.bulk_gift_discount_tiers: Bulk gift discounts are env-driven, not in Stripe. Set BULK_DISCOUNT_TIERS in .env: '10:10,20:20,50:30' (qty:pct).
_notes.patreon_migration_coupon: Create a Stripe Coupon `patreon_migration` (5% off, ~90 day expiry) and a Promotion Code `PATREON5` referencing it. Apply via session `discounts` (auto) or `allow_promotion_codes: true` (manual).
_notes.tier_naming: ref values 'looth2'/'looth3' are internal tier slugs. The product name is what customers see.
